headline: Investors are looking for ways to protect their portfolios from the growing weight of AI stocks.
score_reason: Pool score 7 lowered by 1 because only the headline could be checked.
importance_line: Investors who hold large amounts of AI-linked shares are looking for protection, a sign of growing caution about a market led by a few stocks, but who is moving and on what scale is not reported in the headline.
summary: The Financial Times reports that investors are looking for ways to shelter their portfolios from the growing concentration of risk in AI-related stocks.
notes: FT paywalled (HTTP 403 on fetch). A related FT item of 5 Oct 2026, "Global pension funds cut US equities over AI concentration risk", was found only through a summary on Biggo (it names Australian Retirement Trust, La Caisse and People's Pension) and may be the same reporting, but this was not confirmed, so it is not used in the summary.
